verdict.rationale: Grok's API, custom connectors/tools, and Grok Bot's persistent cloud environment provide building blocks that could be used to script operations across many items (e.g., Salesforce record creation, custom tool schemas), and a batch multipart field appears for one endpoint (speech-to-text). However, there is no documented bulk-operation feature (e.g., batch endpoint for text/chat, multi-item processing pipeline, or explicit 'bulk action' UI) that lets a user act on many items at once as a first-class capability. Missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk API or UI feature, evidence of processing multiple items in a single automated call, and independent confirmation of bulk-task reliability.
